def: prominence, i.e. (figuratively) superiority (in rank or character)

occurrences.text: And I, brethren, when I came to you, came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom, declaring unto you the testimony of God.
For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
